name: nicaragua-social-contributions
description: Use this skill for Nicaragua social security contributions to the INSS in 2026. It gives the rates published by INSS for each affiliation regime, the integral regime (employer 21.5% with fewer than 50 workers, 22.50% with more than 50, employee 7.0%), the IVM-RP regime without health cover (employer 15.5% or 16.50%, employee 5.0%), the voluntary (facultativo) regimes (22.25% integral, 14.00% IVM, on declared income not below the minimum wage), how the employee share reduces taxable salary, and what is still open (ceiling, INATEC, deadlines). Trigger phrases include INSS Nicaragua, cotizacion patronal, cotizacion laboral 7%, regimen integral, seguro facultativo and planilla INSS.
